title: From Attention Masks to Inert Zero-Vector Tokens: OAttention and O-Closure for Token Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2608.21174v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Attention masks are relation-level controls: they specify which query--source pairs may interact. They do not provide a representation-carried token state that is non-participating at the attention boundary. We assign each token hidden carrier \(h_i\) an active-presence coefficient \(p_i=\lVert h_i\rVert^2/(\tau+\lVert h_i\rVert^2)\). The same coefficient has two roles: it gates information emitted by token \(i\), and it determines the mass with which token \(i\) enters computations shared with other tokens.   OAttention is the support-coupled attention realization of this rule. It gates the receiver output by \(p_i\) and weights source \(j\) by \(p_j\) in both the attention numerator and partition, while retaining the standard score, visibility relation, exponential competition, and value aggregation. This makes the zero-vector token a zero element and yields exact null-receiver, null-source insertion, self-attention insertion, and empt

translated_title: 从注意力掩码到惰性零向量令牌：令牌动力学的OAttention与O-Closure机制
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.21174v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：注意力掩码是关系级别的控制手段：它们指定哪些查询-源对可以相互作用。它们并未提供一种在注意力边界处不参与计算的、由表示携带的令牌状态。我们为每个令牌的隐藏载体 \(h_i\) 分配一个活跃存在系数 \(p_i=\lVert h_i\rVert^2/(\tau+\lVert h_i\rVert^2)\)。该系数具有双重作用：它门控令牌 \(i\) 发出的信息，并决定令牌 \(i\) 以何种质量参与与其他令牌共享的计算。OAttention是这种规则的支持耦合注意力实现。它通过 \(p_i\) 门控接收器输出，并在注意力分子和分配中都用 \(p_j\) 加权源 \(j\)，同时保留标准的分数、可见性关系、指数竞争和价值聚合。这使得零向量令牌成为一个零元素，并实现了精确的空接收器、空源插入、自注意力插入和空集处理。
tldr: 本文提出OAttention机制，通过引入活跃存在系数，将零向量令牌转化为注意力中的零元素，从而实现精确的空接收器、空源插入等操作，改进了传统注意力掩码的关系级控制方式。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the OAttention mechanism, which introduces an active-presence coefficient to turn zero-vector tokens into zero elements in attention, enabling precise null-receiver and null-source insertion, improving upon traditional relation-level attention masks.
